concept_map.chapter_overview: Aaj hum NCERT Class 6 Science (Curiosity / जिज्ञासा) ke Chapter 11 — प्रकृति के खजाने — ko padhenge. Is chapter mein Bhoomi aur Surya apni Ajji ke Western Ghats wale gaon mein nature ki amulya sampadaon ko dekhte hain — shuddh hawa, upjaau mitti, dhoop, ped-paudhe, jal aur van. Hum seekhenge ki air mein oxygen kyun zaroori hai, air ka composition kya hai, wind se pinwheel aur windmill kaise chalte hain, soft water kahan milta hai, water kaise bachaya jaaye, aur Sun Earth par energy ka mukhya source kaise hai.
concept_map.welcome: Namaste bacchon! Aaj Smart Board par hum ek bahut sundar chapter shuru karenge — प्रकृति के खजाने. Socho, Bhoomi aur Surya apni Ajji ke ghar gaye hain, jahan pahadiyan, jharne, ped aur taazi hawa hai. Ajji kehti hain — yahan nature ke bahut se khazaane hain jo hamara jeevan samriddh banate hain. Chalo, un khazaano ko milkar samajhte hain — simple words mein, jaise class mein baat karte hain!
learning_outcomes: Prakriti ki amulya sampadaon (hawa, mitti, dhoop, ped, jal) ko pehchanna aur unka jeevan mein mahatva batana
Shvaas, oxygen aur air ke composition (nitrogen 78%, oxygen 21%, anya 1%) ko samajhna; wind, pinwheel aur windmill ka connection jodna
Jal ke daily uses, salt water vs soft (fresh) water ke sources, waste rokne ke upay, water harvesting aur pollution ko explain karna
Sun ko Earth par energy ka mukhya source maan kar plants–animals–humans ke energy connection ko samajhna; van ki paribhasha yaad rakhna

concepts.name: वायु और ऑक्सीजन – साँस का रहस्य
वायु का संघटन, पवन और पवनचक्की

generated.say: Bacchon, pehle story suno — bilkul kitab jaisi. Bhoomi aur Surya school ki chuttiyon mein apni Ajji ke ghar gaye. Ajji Western Ghats ke jungle ke kinare ek gaon mein rehti hain. Wahan ki hawa shehar se zyada taazi aur thandi hai. Aas-paas sundar pahadiyan, jharne, aur kai interesting plants, animals aur birds dikhte hain. Ek dopahar Bhoomi aur Surya Ajji se us jagah ke baare mein aur jaanne ke liye kehte hain. Ajji muskurake bolti hain — Bacchon, kya tum jaante ho ki is jagah nature ki anek sampadaayein hain jo hamara jeevan samriddh banati hain? Yahan ki hawa shuddh, taazi aur sphurtidayak hai. Yahan ki mitti itni upjaau hai ki kai prakar ke jeev-jantuon ko jeevan deti hai. Achhi dhoop bhi aati hai jo kai tarah se upyogi hai. Vibhinn vriksh birds, keet-patangon aur kai jantuon ko bhojan aur aashray dete hain. Ajji poochhti hain — kya tum nature ki aisi kuch aur sampadaon ke baare mein soch sakte ho? Bhoomi kehti hai — hum jal ka upyog peene aur saag-bhaji ugane ke liye karte hain. Ajji kehti hain — Haan, humein in sampadaon ki zaroorat survival aur jeevan ko aasaan banane ke liye hoti hai. Nature ki in sampadaon ke bina Earth par kisi bhi prakar ka jeevan sambhav nahi hai. Hum sab isi nature ka ek hissa hain. Toh pehla lesson — air, soil, sunlight, trees aur water प्रकृति के खजाने hain, aur hum inka hissa hain, malik nahi.
generated.example: Gaon ki taazi hawa, upjaau mitti mein ugti sabziyan, aur pedon par chiriyon ka ghosla — teen alag nature ke khazaane ek saath.
board_lines: प्रकृति की संपदाएँ = हवा, मृदा, धूप, वृक्ष, जल
इनके बिना पृथ्वी पर जीवन संभव नहीं
हम प्रकृति का ही एक भाग हैं
generated.common_mistake: Bacche sochte hain nature ke khazaane sirf sona-chandi jaise cheezein hain — actually clean air, fertile soil, sunlight, trees aur water hi asli amulya sampada hain.
generated.memory_trick: H-M-D-P-J: हवा – मृदा – धूप – पेड़ – जल — nature ke paanch bade khazaane.
generated.gesture_action: Haath se aas-paas hawa, mitti (neeche), sooraj (upar), ped (khada) aur pani (peene ka gesture) dikhao
real_life_examples: School ke bagiche ki mitti mein phool ugna — upjaau mitti ka upyog
Subah park mein taazi hawa mein saans lena — shuddh air ka fayda

worked_example.problem: Ajji kehte hain nature ki sampadaon ke bina Earth par jeevan sambhav nahi. Teen sampadaon ke naam likho aur ek-ek line mein unka fayda batao.
steps: Story se teen sampadaayein choose karo: hawa, mitti/jal, dhoop ya ped
Har ek ka short fayda likho — jaise hawa saans ke liye, jal peene/ugane ke liye, dhoop energy/garami ke liye
Conclude: yeh sab survival aur comfortable life ke liye zaroori hain
worked_example.answer: Hawa — saans aur health; Jal — peena aur fasal; Dhoop/Ped — garami-prakash aur aashray-bhojan. Inke bina jeevan mushkil/asambhav.

medium: Bhoomi ne jal ke kaun-kaun se do upyog bataye? Ajji ne unhe kyun zaroori kaha?

generated.concept: वायु और ऑक्सीजन – साँस का रहस्य
generated.say: Ab Ajji air ka mahatva samjhaati hain. Ek subah Bhoomi aur Surya Ajji ko shvaas-sambandhi vyayam karte dekhte hain. Ajji unhe bhi bulati hain aur kehti hain — Main gehri saans le rahi hoon aur baahar chhod rahi hoon. Yeh kriya lungs mein shuddh hawa lene mein madad karti hai aur humein swasth rakhti hai. Chalo, Activity 11.1 jaisa hum bhi try karte hain — pehle ek gehri saans lo aur dheere chhodo; phir aur gehri saans lo; jitna sambhav ho saans rokkar rakho, phir dheere chhodo. Lekin caution yaad rakho — itni der mat rokna ki discomfort ho. Is activity se pata chalta hai ki saans ko lambe time tak rokna mushkil hai. Kyun? Kyunki jo air hum andar lete hain usmein oxygen hoti hai. Hamare shareer ko kaam karne ke liye oxygen chahiye. Jab hum der tak saans rokte hain, shareer ko kaafi oxygen nahi milti. Isliye jeene ke liye humein kaafi oxygen chahiye. Anya jeevon ko bhi jeene ke liye oxygen ki zaroorat hoti hai. Ek aur strong baat kitab kehti hai — hum bhojan ya jal ke bina kuch din jee sakte hain, lekin oxygen ke bina kuch pal bhi nahi. Toh air sirf 'hawa' nahi — yeh jeevan ki pehli zaroorat hai. Jab bhi tum gehri saans lo, socho — lungs shuddh air le rahe hain, oxygen aa rahi hai, shareer kaam kar raha hai.
generated.example: Daudne ke baad muh kholkar saans lena — shareer ko jaldi zyada oxygen chahiye hoti hai.

भोजन/जल के बिना कुछ दिन; O₂ के बिना कुछ क्षण भी नहीं

generated.memory_trick: O₂ = Immediate Life: Food/water delay chal sakta hai, oxygen wait nahi karti.
generated.gesture_action: Poori class ke saath 3 gehri saans (inhale–hold short–exhale) karo, phir poocho — rukne par kaisa laga?

Pahadon par thakaan jaldi — oxygen thodi kam milne ka asar

Body ko kaam karne ke liye continuous oxygen chahiye
Saans rokne par sufficient oxygen nahi milti, isliye uncomfortable/mushkil hota hai
worked_example.answer: Kyunki shvaas se mili oxygen shareer ke kaam ke liye zaroori hai; der tak rokne par kaafi oxygen nahi milti, isliye saans rokna mushkil hota hai.

easy: Shvaas dwara andar li gayi air mein kaunsi gas hoti hai jo jeene ke liye zaroori hai?
medium: Ajji shvaas-vyayam kyun karti hain? Do fayde likho.

generated.concept: वायु का संघटन, पवन और पवनचक्की
generated.say: Ab thoda aur deep jaate hain. Tumne pedon ki pattiyon ki sarsarahat, rassi par latke kapdon ka hilna, pankha chalana, ya khuli kitab ke panne — in sab se air ki maujoodgi mehsoos ki hogi. Jo air chalti hai, use पवन (wind) kehte hain. Kabhi yeh bahut tez hoti hai — jaise aandhi — aur kabhi dheemi, jaise बयार (gentle breeze). Activity 11.2 mein hum paper ki phirki banate hain — 15 cm × 15 cm square paper, scissors, all-pin aur soft stick. Jab tum phirki pakadkar daudte ho ya phoonkte ho, woh ghoomti hai. Kaun ghuma raha hai? Wind! Windmill aur phirki ki working almost same hai — wind unke pankhon ko ghumaati hai. Windmill se aata peesna, kuen se pani khinchna, ya electricity banana ho sakta hai. Windmill farm woh area hai jahan kai windmills wind-energy se bijli banate hain — jaise Tamil Nadu ka Muppandal, Rajasthan Jaisalmer ka windmill park, aur Maharashtra ka Brahmawel. Ab composition: Earth ke chaaron taraf air kai gases ka mixture hai — nitrogen, oxygen, argon, carbon dioxide aur bahut kam anya gases. Figure 11.1 jaisa socho — 100 squares: 78 nitrogen, 21 oxygen, aur 1 anya gases (argon, CO₂ etc.). Percent matlab har 100 mein se kitne hisse — isse % se dikhate hain. Yaad rakho numbers: 78%, 21%, 1%.
generated.example: Paper ki phirki ko daudte hue ghumana — seedha proof ki moving air (wind) kaam kar sakti hai.
board_lines: वायु = गैसों का मिश्रण: N₂ 78%, O₂ 21%, अन्य 1%
चलती वायु = पवन (तेज = आँधी; मंद = बयार)
पवनचक्की → आटा / पानी खींचना / विद्युत; windmill farm
generated.common_mistake: Bacche air ko sirf oxygen maante hain — actually sabse zyada hissa nitrogen (78%) hai, oxygen 21% hai.
generated.memory_trick: N-O-A: Ninety? No — Nitrogen Seventy-eight, Oxygen twenty-one, Anya one. Yaad: 78-21-1.
generated.gesture_action: Ek haath se phirki ghumao, doosre haath se board par 78 / 21 / 1 likho
real_life_examples: Kapde sukhate waqt hawa se hilna — wind ki maujoodgi
Jaisalmer ya coastal areas ke windmill farms — bijli ke liye wind energy

worked_example.problem: Agar air ko 100 equal parts mein baantein, toh nitrogen, oxygen aur anya gases ke kitne-kitne parts honge?
steps: NCERT figure yaad karo: 100 squares = 100%
Nitrogen = 78 squares, Oxygen = 21 squares
Anya gases (argon, CO₂ etc.) = 1 square
worked_example.answer: Nitrogen 78 parts, Oxygen 21 parts, anya gases 1 part.

easy: Chalti hui air ko kya kehte hain? Mand wind ka Hindi naam likho.
medium: Phirki aur windmill mein similarity kya hai? Windmill ke teen upyog likho.
hard: Air ke composition ko percent mein likho aur batao ki 'percent' ka kya arth hai. Bharat ke do windmill farms ke naam bhi do.

generated.summary: Air gases ka mixture hai (N₂ 78%, O₂ 21%, anya 1%); moving air wind hai jo phirki aur windmill chalati hai — windmills se bijli bhi milti hai.
generated.revision_point: 78-21-1 composition; wind moves pinwheel/windmill; famous farms: Muppandal, Jaisalmer, Brahmawel.
generated.exam_tip: Composition ke percentages bilkul sahi likho (78, 21, 1) — 1-mark sawal aksar yahin se aata hai.
generated.source_text_hint: वायु में नाइट्ोजन, ऑकसीजन, आर्गन, कार्बन डाइ‌ऑक्साइड और सूक्ष्म मात्रा में अन्य गैसें उपस्थित होती हैं।

generated.say: Air ke baad Ajji jal ki taraf le jaati hain — kyunki jal bhi atyadhik zaroori aur amulya hai. Socho, pyaas lage aur peene ko pani na mile — kaisa lagega? Bhoomi aur Surya Ajji ki madad karte hain — gayon ke liye naand mein pani bharna, bagiche mein saag-bhaji aur aushadhiye paudhon ko pani dena. Ajji sikhati hain ki paudhon ko aise pani do ki har boond kaam aaye, ek bhi boond waste na ho. Daily life mein jal ke kai upyog hain — peena, khana banana, nahana, kapde dhona, safai. Fasalen ugane aur industrial kaamon ke liye bhi jal chahiye. Ab sources: Earth ki surface ka lagbhag do-tihai hissa jal se ghira hai. Zyadatar jal oceans aur samudron mein hai, lekin woh namkeen (laveen/salt) hota hai — isliye ghar, kheti aur industry ke liye suitable nahi. In sab ke liye humein मृदु जल yani soft/fresh water (lavan-rahit) chahiye. Yeh ice sheets/hima, nadiyon, jheelon mein aur surface ke neeche भू-जल ke roop mein milta hai. Ice sheets, snow ya groundwater se soft water nikalna mushkil hota hai. Thodi matra mein soft water talaabon, nadiyon, jheelon aur kuon se asani se mil sakta hai. Isliye Ajji unhe jal ka vivek-purna upyog sikha rahi hain — kyunki soft water limited hai, samundar ka pani seedha use nahi ho sakta.
generated.example: Samundar ka pani bahut hai, phir bhi pyaas mein woh peene layak nahi — humein soft water chahiye jo nadi, kuen ya jheel se aata hai.
board_lines: उपयोग: पीना, खाना, नहाना, कपड़े, सफाई, खेती, उद्योग
≈ 2/3 पृथ्वी जल; अधिकतर समुद्री = लवणीय
मृदु जल = नदियाँ/झीलें/तालाब/कुएँ + हिम + भू-जल
generated.common_mistake: Bacche sochte hain Earth par itna pani hai toh shortage nahi ho sakti — actually usable soft water bahut limited hai; ocean water salty hai.
generated.memory_trick: SALT can't serve home-farm-factory; SOFT water can — Soft = nadi, jheel, kuen, groundwater.
generated.gesture_action: Ek glass 'samundar' (peene se mana) aur ek glass 'kuen ka pani' (peene layak) dikhakar contrast clear karo
real_life_examples: Ghar ka handpump ya nalka — aksar groundwater/soft water
Kheti mein fasal ko pani dena — agriculture use of water

worked_example.problem: Ocean water domestic, agricultural aur industrial use ke liye kyun suitable nahi? Humein kis prakar ka jal chahiye aur woh kahan milta hai?
steps: Ocean water laveen/namkeen hota hai
Home, farm, industry ke liye soft (fresh) water chahiye
Soft water ice/hima, nadi, jheel aur groundwater mein milta hai; asani se talaab/nadi/jheel/kuen se
worked_example.answer: Kyunki ocean water salty hai. Humein soft water chahiye jo nadi, jheel, talaab, kuen, ice/hima aur groundwater se milta hai.

easy: Daily life ke chaar kaamon ke naam likho jinke liye jal chahiye.
medium: Laveen jal aur mridu jal mein antar batao. Mridu jal ke teen sources likho.
hard: 'Prithvi ka do-tihai hissa jal se ghira hai, phir bhi jal amulya hai' — is virodhabhas ko soft water ke logic se samjhao.

generated.summary: Jal peene se lekar kheti-udyog tak zaroori hai; Earth par zyada jal salty oceans mein hai, isliye limited soft water (nadi, jheel, kuen, groundwater) ka vivek-purna upyog karna chahiye.
generated.revision_point: Most water = salty oceans; usable = soft water from rivers/lakes/wells/groundwater/ice.
generated.exam_tip: Difference table banao: लवणीय जल vs मृदु जल — sources + uses — 3-mark ke liye perfect.
generated.source_text_hint: इन सभी गतिविधियों के लिए हमें मृदु (लवण-र‍हित या अलवणीय) जल की आवश्यकता होती है

generated.say: Ab important part — jal waste mat karo, bachao, aur ganda mat karo. Activity 11.3 mein Table 11.1 jaise socho: haath dhona, kapde dhona, bartan, nahana, khana pakana, bagwani, daant saaf karna — kis activity mein jal waste ho raha hai aur kaise rokhein? Kai methods hain — use na ho toh nal band karo, leakage theek karwao. Jal ka recycling aur water harvesting bhi bachane mein madad karte hain. Humara desh nadiyon, jharnon aur jheelon se samriddh hai, lekin log plastic bags aur wrappers paani par tairte chhod dete hain. Gharon aur udyogon ke waste jab water sources se milte hain toh jal pradooshit hota hai. Pradooshit jal sajeewon ke upyog ke liye theek nahi. Soft water limited hone se Bharat ke kai hisso mein kami hai; kuch jagah logon ko peene ka pani laane door chalna padta hai. Sabke paas barabar availability nahi, isliye conservation aur vivek-purna upyog zaroori hai. Water harvesting ek method hai — kai buildings mein barish ka jal baad ke liye collect karke store kiya jaata hai — इसे वर्षा जल संचयन kehte hain. Bharat mein yeh parampara sadiyon se hai. Rajasthan aur Gujarat mein baavdi aur vaav banaye gaye — unmein barish ka jal aur aas-paas jheel-talaab-nadi se rise hua jal bhi collect hota hai. Har saal 22 March ko World Water Day manaya jaata hai. Toh rule simple: Save, Harvest, Don't Pollute.
generated.example: Daant brush karte waqt nal khula chhodna — chhoti aadat se bahut pani waste hota hai; mug use karo toh bachta hai.
board_lines: बचाओ: नल बंद / रिसाव ठीक / पुनः चक्रण / संचयन
वर्षा जल संचयन; बावड़ी–वाव (राजस्थान, गुजरात)
प्रदूषण: प्लास्टिक, घर–उद्योग अपशिष्ट → जल अनुपयुक्त
generated.common_mistake: Bacche sochte hain sirf factory se hi water pollution hota hai — ghar ka kachra, plastic bags aur wrappers bhi soft water sources ko ganda karte hain.
generated.memory_trick: 3S of Water: Shut the tap, Store the rain, Stop the waste/pollution.
generated.gesture_action: Nal band karne ka gesture, phir haath se 'barish ka pani tank mein' dikhao, phir plastic phenkne ka 'NO' signal
real_life_examples: School building ke roof se barish ka pani tank mein — rainwater harvesting
Jodhpur ki Toorji ka Jhalra (baavdi) — traditional water storage

worked_example.problem: Table socho: 'daant saaf karna' mein jal kaise waste hota hai aur ek upay likho. Saath hi rainwater harvesting ek line mein define karo.
steps: Waste: brush karte waqt continuous running tap se pani bekaar jaata hai
Upay: mug/glass mein pani le kar brush karo; nal band rakho
Definition: buildings mein barish ka jal baad ke use ke liye collect/store karna = वर्षा जल संचयन
worked_example.answer: Running tap se waste; mug use karke bachayein. Rainwater harvesting = barish ke jal ko later use ke liye ektra/sangrahit karna.

generated.say: Ab Surya ki baari! Humne pehle seekha tha ki Suraj jal ke evaporation mein important role nibhata hai. Bhoomi aur Surya dopahar ki kadi dhoop mein Ajji ko mirch sukhane mein madad kar rahe hain. Ajji kehti hain — hum inhe sukhane ke liye Suraj ki garami use karte hain; jab taazi mirch na ho toh sookhi mirch kaam aati hai. Earth par energy ka mukhya source Suraj hai; saare plants aur animals isi par depend hain. Hum Suraj ki heat aur light kai kaamon mein use karte hain — plants dwara food banana, kapde sukhana. Rooftops, poles aur traffic signals par solar panels dikhe honge — yeh solar energy collect karke bijli banate hain. Solar cooker mein khana aur solar water heater mein pani garam kiya ja sakta hai. Ab smart conversation: ek kehta hai gay ghaas se energy leti hai; doosra kehta hai energy Suraj se hai; teesra kehta hai sirf dhoop mein khadi hone se energy nahi milti. Sahi baat — gay ghaas khati hai, lekin ghaas ko badhne ke liye sunlight chahiye; isliye mukhya source Suraj hi hai. Bin Suraj jeevan mushkil: plants Suraj se food banate hain, animals plants khate hain, hum dono se food lete hain — yeh cycle Suraj se possible hai. Kai parivaron mein subah Suraj ko jal arpit karke kritagyata dikhate hain.
